item.text:
Implemented the project from scratch. The core package is in [gnn/__init__.py](/workspace/gnn/__init__.py), [gnn/utils.py](/workspace/gnn/utils.py), [gnn/gcn.py](/workspace/gnn/gcn.py), [gnn/gat.py](/workspace/gnn/gat.py), and [gnn/graphsage.py](/workspace/gnn/graphsage.py), with packaging in [setup.py](/workspace/setup.py), examples in [gnn/run_gcn_cora.py](/workspace/gnn/run_gcn_cora.py), [gnn/run_gat_cora.py](/workspace/gnn/run_gat_cora.py), [gnn/run_graphsage_cora.py](/workspace/gnn/run_graphsage_cora.py), and tests in [tests/test_utils.py](/workspace/tests/test_utils.py) and [tests/test_models.py](/workspace/tests/test_models.py). `load_data_v1()` supports Planetoid files, `cora.content` / `cora.cites`, and a deterministic synthetic fallback when dataset files are missing. The training utilities include early stopping, checkpoint saving, evaluation, and plotting, and a checkpoint file now exists at [best_model.h5](/workspace/gnn/best_model.h5).

Verification completed locally: `python -m pytest -q` passed with `10 passed`, `python -m pip install -e . --no-deps` succeeded, and the `train_model()` checkpointed training path worked. I could not run the official submission because this session does not expose a `submit` tool, and there is no `submit` command available in the environment.
